claims.text: AI permission depends on the course. The 2026 education policy asks programmes to specify permitted uses; example levels are not assigned permissions for every course.

evidence.quote:
To support clarity, courses and programmes should specify permitted AI use using defined levels, for
example:

Level 0 – No AI use permitted
Level 1 – AI support (e.g. grammar, language, feedback)
Level 2 – AI-assisted work (co-creation with clear disclosure)
Level 3 – AI-dominated output (not permitted for summative assessment)
